description: Update an existing New Quiz (LTI) in a Canvas course, found by its assignment_id (from list_assignments or get_assignment, filtered on is_quiz_lti_assignment, or from create_new_quiz — not a Classic Quiz ID). Only the fields you pass change; omitted fields keep their current value, so a repeated call with the same payload leaves the quiz unchanged. Pass null for due_at, unlock_at, or lock_at to clear that date. Returns the updated quiz (id, title, points_possible, due_at, unlock_at, lock_at, published, assignment_id). Use update_new_quiz_item to change an individual question instead of the quiz shell, and delete_new_quiz to remove the whole quiz. Requires permission to manage quizzes in the course.

assignment_id.description: The assignment ID of the New Quiz

instructions.description: HTML instructions shown before the quiz starts

published.description: Whether the quiz is visible to students

name: update_new_quiz
title: Update New Quiz
